chapter.verse: Tate aw, Topa' sungah na nulehpa' thu na mang un. Tua pen a dik thu ahi hi.
“Na nu leh na pa zahtak in.”(Hih pen thupiakna a masa hi-in hih bangin kamciam khat tawh kizom hi:)
“Tua hileh nang' ading nate hong lemin leitung ah hinsawt khansau na nungta ding hi.”
Pate aw, na tate a hehsuah nading bawl kei unla Topa' sungah pattahna leh hilhphawnna tawh khansuah un.
Silate aw, Khris' thu na man mah bangun launa linna leh lungsim sungtawng a siangtho tawh na leitung tote uh' thu na mang un.
Muhna beka sem, mi a pum mai-ette bang hilo-in lungsim takpi tawh Pasian' deihna a sem Khris' silate bang hita un.
Mi' ading ahilo, Topa' ading tanuk nasep a sem bangin thanuamtak sem un.
Sila ahi-a tualmi suakta ahi zongin, mi khatpeuh in thuhoih a bawl leh Topa' kiangpan thupha sangkik ding cih thei ta un.
Tote aw, tu-a bangin silate' tungah bawl un. Amaute leh note' Topa vantung ah om cih thu leh tua Topa in guptuam paihtuam nei lo cih thu thei unla, na lauphawnna uh zang nawnkei un.
A tawpna ah Topa' sung leh ama' hihzawhna vanglian sungah thakhauhin om un.
Dawimangpa' khembawlna teng na nan zawh nadingun Pasian' galvan a bucingin silh un.
A hang pen si leh sa tawh a kilai i hikei a, eite' kilaipih pen zaliante, ukna thuneite, leitung khuamial gam a uk khate, van gamhuam sunga gilo kha vangliatnate ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin hunsiat ni ah na dintang zawh nadingun leh na khempuh zosiangin na dinkip zawh nadingun Pasian' galvan a bucingin silh un.
Tua hi a, thumaan thutak kawnggak gakin diktatna awmdal thuah un.
Na khe uhah nopna lemna tawh kipawl Lungdamna Thu pana hong pai kiginkholhna khedap bulh un.
Gilopa' mei thaltangte na sukmit theih nadingun thu khempeuh ah upna lum tawi un.
Hotkhiatna siklukhu khu unla, Pasian' kammal ahi Kha namsau tawi un.
Hehpih ngetna leh thumna a namkim tawh Kha sungah thungen tawntung un. Tua bang dingin thuakzawhna lianpi leh mi siangtho khempeuh' ading thumsakna tawh pilvangin om un.
Kei' ading zong tua thusim, Lungdamna Thu, hangtak hilhkhia dingin ka kam ka hon ciangin ka thugen ding ka ngah nading ahi zongin,
tua thu hangin khutkol kibulh taangmi ulian ka hih manin genhuai thute suaktatak ka gen ngam nading ahi zongin, thu hong ngetsak un.
Kei tawh kisai-in thulelate bangci danin om cih note in zong na theih theih nadingun Topa' sunga sanggam it, nasem citak ahi Tychicus in thu khempeuh hong gen ding hi.
Kote bangci om cih nong theih nadingun leh note' lungsim hong noptuamsak theih nading cihna tawh note' kiangah amah hong paisak ka hi hi.
Sanggamte' tungah nopna lemna hong om henla Pa ahi Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan upna tawh a kiton itna hong tung ta hen.
A siatheilo itna tawh i Topa Jesu Khris a itte khempeuh' tungah hehpihna hong om ta hen.
